description: This file defines functions and methods related to handling HTTP redirects, including computing redirect methods, processing referrer policies, and constructing redirect information objects within the 'net' namespace.

classes.name: RedirectInfo
classes.description: A class encapsulating information about an HTTP redirect, including status code, new URL, method, referrer policy, and other redirect-related data.

methods.name: ComputeMethodForRedirect
methods.description: Determines the HTTP method to use after a redirect based on the original method and status code.

methods.name: ProcessReferrerPolicyHeaderOnRedirect
methods.description: Parses the Referrer-Policy header during a redirect and determines the effective referrer policy.

methods.name: RedirectInfo::ComputeRedirectInfo
methods.description: Constructs a RedirectInfo object with updated redirect details based on input parameters, including URL, method, referrer, and policies.
